name: SmartSuite
summary: One flexible work management platform to plan, track and automate any process. Projects, CRM and operations side by side — replace a stack of scattered tools with a single source of truth.
best_for: teams consolidating projects, CRM and operations into one flexible, database-driven work-management platform
skip_if: you need a lightweight to-do or a single-purpose tool — SmartSuite's breadth is wasted and its learning curve isn't worth it
honest_knock: It's a broad, do-everything work-management platform, so the power comes with a learning curve and a per-seat cost that adds up for bigger teams — a single source of truth if you commit, overkill if you just need a task list.

pricing.plans_source: summarised from pricing.notes; every plan name and amount appears verbatim in those notes
pricing.notes: (re-verified 2026-10-02 on their own pricing page, USD; unchanged since our August reading) No free plan — a 14-day trial of Professional with no credit card, and the page states there is no auto-charge when it ends. Team is $15 per seat a month billed annually, or $20 billed monthly, with a minimum of 3 billable users, 5,000 records per solution, 50GB of storage and a 30-day recycle bin. Professional is $32 per seat annually, or $36 monthly, with a minimum of 5 billable users, 100,000 records, 100GB and 45 days. Enterprise is quote-only and lifts those to 400,000 records, 500GB and 60 days, adding SSO, SCIM, audit logs, IP restrictions, data-loss prevention and European data residency; a further Signature plan sits above it, also on request and, per the FAQ, priced per solution rather than per seat. The minimums matter more than the rate: a three-person team on Team pays for three seats whether or not all three log in, and Professional cannot be bought for fewer than five, so the real entry price is $45 a month on Team and $160 on Professional rather than the per-seat figures on the cards. The FAQ adds that Enterprise has no seat minimum and that read-only users, commenters and form submitters are not billed.
